subject: A daytime view from lower-level box seats along the third-base line, looking out over an entire classic ballpark: the green infield and outfield grass, an ivy-covered brick outfield wall curving around the field, an old dark-green hand-operated board of blank panels above the center-field bleachers, and rooftop bleachers on three-story brick apartment buildings across the street beyond the outfield. Late-afternoon sun, a clear deep-blue sky left open in the upper left. The backs of a few empty green seats in the lower foreground.
headline: I paid for the same four
Wrigley seats for 18 years.
After inflation, the price rose
13.0% in the first 11
and 44.9% in the last six.
